notes.source: bazarr/app/ui.py:71-72 (fix parent): @ui_bp.route('/<path:path>') on `def catch_all(path):` - the whole URL path after the hostname, a Flask <path:...> route parameter (the outer decorator @ui_bp.route('/', defaults={'path': ''}) at :70 only defaults it)
notes.sink: bazarr/app/ui.py:79 (fix parent): `return send_file(os.path.join(frontend_build_path, path))` (send_file) - the request path is joined to frontend/build and served, and os.path.join collapses '..', so a value such as workbox-../../../../etc/passwd names a file outside the build directory
notes.between: the branch at :78 is the only gate: `if path in pwa_assets or path.startswith('workbox-'):` - a three-name list and a bare prefix test, neither of which constrains '..' - and it is tested before authentication (:81-91 only runs for the paths that fall through), so the traversal is unauthenticated. `path` then goes unchanged into os.path.join(frontend_build_path, path) at :79 (frontend_build_path is built at :23) with no basename, normalisation or containment check before send_file. The miss: the prefix test sits in an `if` whose branch returns, which matches the shared validated-guard sanitizer `if <... $X.startswith(...) ...>: ... return ...` (catalog/codewatch/rules/python-web.yml), so tainted `path` is taken as sanitised exactly where the sink is; the positive `path in pwa_assets` membership test is not a sanitizer by itself (only a failed `not ... in ...` check is). Second explanation: sink (send_file on a path built with os.path.join).
notes.fix: normalises the joined path and returns 404 unless it starts with os.path.realpath(frontend_build_path) + os.sep, then serves the normalised path
